findings.text: `from` already has a meaning on a task: the asker's agent id for requests (`page_tools.js:1316`, `Servex/agents/doc/messaging.md:35-37`). Now a voice task stores `from: {prompt, sentence}`. When it completes, `notify_requests` (`page_tools.js:762-764`) passes that object as `to` to `hooks.answered` (`Servex/Servex.js:300`), so the notice is sent to an object and fails silently. The asker stamp is also skipped, because `a.from` is already set, so the voice assistant never hears the outcome. The brief warned about one clash over the word `from` (deliverable 1) but missed this one. Either guard `answered` to accept only a string `from`, or keep the asker separately (for example `asker`), and say which in messaging.md.

Deliverable 3 asks for proof that the ref lines come "in order, after the owner's bubble that holds from.sentence's prompt". `ask1-origin.test.mjs:41-43` only checks that some Ref exists. There is no owner bubble in the fixture, the test adds one task (not several), and it checks no order.

Deliverable 4 says `text` = the owner's words verbatim, in "one short sentence". The example at `single-voice-assistant.md:57` still has the third-person paraphrase "The tab bar is broken on the owner's phone." (the test uses "my phone"), and no sentence was added saying `text` is the owner's raw words. A voice agent copying the example will keep paraphrasing.

The new file `Servex/agents/handoff-note.js` and the new export `task_origin` (`page_tools.js:728`) are not indexed. The file list in `Servex/agents/readme.md:114-117` does not name them, nor the test `ask1-origin.test.mjs`. No doc says that a handoff's first message now quotes the owner's words (Law 9/10).

The owner's words reach the mastermind only through `spawn_agent task: {from, id}` (`Agents.js:230`, `:250`). The brief's other route, "message `mastermind-voice-system`" (`single-voice-assistant.md:54`), carries just the id, so that mastermind must read the session itself.

`Agents.js` is not exercised by any test, because the SDK dependency is missing in the worktree (task log). The code reads the origin before `open_task` starts the unawaited `move_item`, which looks right, but no live spawn has proved it. One handoff after the merge would confirm it.
The test file is named after the task slug (`ask1-origin.test.mjs`), not the code it covers. A name like `task-origin.test.mjs` would be easier to find later.

findings.text: The proof for deliverable 3 (one ref line per task, in order, after the owner's bubble) is not committed. It exists only as an uncommitted edit to `Servex/agents/task-origin.test.mjs` in the worktree `qf-2`. `review/diff.patch` (commit 5d1b2fc43) still holds the old check, which only asks "is there any Ref?". Commit the edit. With it, the test passes 12 of 12 (run 2026-11-03).

In that uncommitted test, the test file writes the owner's bubble itself, before any task (`task-origin.test.mjs`, the `messages.add` Prompt line). So "after the bubble" is true just because of the setup. A bubble written by `ChatWriter.owner()` would prove the real order.

With an object `from`, the asker stamp is skipped (`page_tools.js:1319`, which checks `a.from === undefined`). So a voice-filed task gets no automatic "it's done" notice when it completes. `Servex/agents/doc/messaging.md:40` records this as a tradeoff. The owner did not ask for the notice, but the voice session will not hear about completion unless the mastermind tells it.

`from` now has three meanings on a task: an asker's agent id, a Prompt id (a Question's `from`, `core/Task/doc/prompt.md:37`), and the new `{prompt, sentence}` object. `messaging.md:40` names only the first two clashes; one line in `core/Task/readme.md` listing all three would help the next reader.

The owner's words reach the mastermind only through `spawn_agent task: {from, id}` (`Agents.js:230`, `:250`). If the voice assistant messages `mastermind-voice-system` instead (`single-voice-assistant.md:54`), only the id goes along. No live spawn has exercised the `Agents.js` path yet; one handoff after the merge would confirm it.
